shared_elements: low-relief carved figural frieze on a horizontal band
procession/movement in a single direction along the band
bearded male figures with patterned hair/headgear
animals shown with legs overlapping in file
justification: Both are horizontal low-relief friezes of profile human figures and profile quadrupeds moving in a single direction, rendered with comparably naturalistic musculature and patterned hair, which is a real but broad correspondence. The subjects differ substantially: A shows a calm procession of walking attendants leading a laden camel, framed by rosette borders, while B shows a violent hunt with archers in a wheeled chariot drawn by galloping horses attacking lions, with no ornamental border.
